## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The rewrite of `requirement_proven` breaks release gating and must be fixed before merge: with an empty criteria list it now returns `True`, which contradicts the description's "No behavior change is intended." The other 182 changed handler files are mechanical; the type-hint, `log.warning` and `itemgetter` replacements keep the same behavior.

## Changes
The pull request replaces `typing.List`/`Dict` with built-in generics and `log.warn` with `log.warning` in 181 handler modules. It swaps a lambda sort key for `operator.itemgetter` in `h040_sorting.py`, rewrites the all-proven check in `h091_requirements.py` as a sum-versus-length comparison, and adds a one-line `review.txt`.

## Critical
- app/handlers/h091_requirements.py:12 — correctness — Return False again when criteria is empty — With `criteria=[]`, `requirement_proven` now returns `True` because `sum(...)` is 0 and `len(criteria)` is 0. The removed line returned `bool(criteria) and all(...)`, which gave `False`. Line 10 logs a warning, but execution then continues to the vacuous success. — A requirement with no criteria now counts as proven in release review, so an unverified release can pass the gate. — Fix: Restore the `bool(criteria) and ...` guard and add an empty-list case to `test_requirement_proof` in `tests/test_handlers.py:17`; this review found no existing test that calls `requirement_proven([])`.
